One day her elder or younger sister all met at the army front; Fengxian prompted men to falsely accuse consort's husband Xiao Yu and Yudu and others of plotting to set up the Prince of Jin; when the matter was exposed Yu, Tayehexi, and others were executed, and Literary Consort was also ordered to die;

One day her elder and younger sisters both met at the army front; Fengxian prompted men to falsely accuse imperial son-in-law Xiao Yu and Yudu and others of plotting to set up the Prince of Jin; when the matter was exposed Yu, Tayehexi, and others were executed, and Literary Consort was also ordered to die;
姊若妹 refers collectively to Literary Consort's elder and younger sisters, and 駙馬 identifies Xiao Yu as an imperial son-in-law.

縣 makes Zhulüshan a county. The revision also removes the displaced [2] note marker and renders the offices as English titles rather than 'knower of ... affairs.'

縣 is county. The literal revision preserves 將所部兵 while removing the [2] note marker, which belongs after the previous source clause.
Hearing Yudu had led Jin commander Wanyan Wushi to arrive suddenly, Xiao Fengxian said, "Yudu is of the Prince Ban line; he comes intending to set up his nephew the Prince of Jin.

Hearing that Yudu had brought the Jin commander Wanyan Wushi in a sudden advance, Xiao Fengxian said, "Yudu is descended from the imperial prince class; he has come only to enthrone his nephew, the Prince of Jin.
王子班 is an institutional prince-class lineage, not a man named Ban. The revision keeps that correction while making the sentence idiomatic.

Chuwenn was made Defender Grand Mentor; Zuo Qigong Defender of the State; Cao Yongyi was made knower of privy council affairs; Yu Zhongwen third-rank knower of government affairs; Zhang Lin Defender of the State grand mentor; Li Chuneng direct privy council; Li as junior palace supervisor and director of Hanlin medical officers; Li Shuang, Chen Mi, and more than ten others who had shared in the great plan were all granted advanced-scholar standing and given office in differing degrees.

Chuwen was appointed acting Grand Commandant; Zuo Qigong, acting Minister over the Masses; Cao Yongyi, director of privy council affairs; Yu Zhongwen, assistant director of state affairs; Zhang Lin, acting Grand Preceptor; Li Chuneng, attendant of the privy council; and Li Shi, junior director of the court of imperial manufactories and supervisor of the Hanlin medical officers. Li Shuang, Chen Mi, and more than ten others who had participated in the great plan were all granted the presented scholar degree and appointed to offices of varying rank.

The proposal correctly repairs 守, but 太師 is Grand Preceptor, not Grand Mentor. The received Chinese also corrupts 參知政事 as 三知政事 and drops 奭 after 李; the source witness restores Yu Zhongwen's office and Li Shi's name.

On wuxu day of the eighth month Tianzuo personally encountered Jin troops; they fought at Stone Carriage Post; [5] were defeated; commander-in-chief Xiao Temu and his Sagun were captured.
On the wuxu day of the eighth month, Tianzuo personally encountered the Jin army at Stone Carriage Post and suffered a defeat. Commander-in-Chief Xiao Temu and Sagun were captured.
The proposal removes the [5] textual-note marker, but 其撒古 is the named officer Sagun, not 'his Sagun.' The sentence also needs an explicit subject for 敗績.
On jiazi day, earlier Zhang Cang had been Liao Xingjun Army associate military commissioner; [6] the people pushed Cang to lead prefectural affairs.
On the jiazi day, Zhang Jue, formerly deputy military commissioner of the Liaoxing Army, was acclaimed by the people to take charge of the prefecture.
The proposal correctly removes [6], but 張倉 is the corrupted name of the well-attested Pingzhou commander Zhang Jue; the note and the parallel Jin history identify him as 張覺.
Consort's husband commandant Runu went to Jin in surrender.

Thereupon he sent Zhang Qian with more than five hundred horsemen, carrying the military governor's order, to summon Chancellor Zuo Qigong, Cao Yongyi, Privy Commissioner Yu Zhongwen, and Assistant Director of State Affairs Kang Gongbi to the west bank of the Luan River. He then sent Secretary Collator Zhao to enumerate their ten crimes: "Tianzuo was driven to Jia Mountain, yet you did not immediately go to welcome him: that is the first offense;
The [7] apparatus marker should be removed. The received 三知政事 is a corruption of 參知政事, and 數十罪 means to enumerate the ten offenses that immediately follow, not several tens of crimes.
Arriving at the Wugu Dilie tribe, chief palace-front inspector Xiao Yixue was made knower of Northern Court privy commissioner affairs; Moheshi was enfeoffed Spirit-at-Khan King of Yue.
On reaching the Wugu Dilie tribe, chief palace-front inspector Xiao Yixue was put in charge of Northern Court privy commissioner affairs; Moheshi was enfeoffed as divine yuyue prince.
于越 is a high Khitan title, not Yue the territorial principality. 'Divine Yuyue Prince' preserves the compound title without the unsupported khan calque.

In the seventh autumn month Jin men encamped at Laizhou; hearing Ping Prefecture had attached to Song, with two thousand horsemen they demanded satisfaction, [8] first entering Ying Prefecture.
In the seventh autumn month, Jin forces encamped at Laizhou. When Zhamu learned that Ping Prefecture had joined Song, he led two thousand horsemen into Ying Prefecture to punish the defection.

The [8] apparatus marker should be removed. The received text dropped 闍 from the Jin commander's name 闍母; the Song history's parallel account identifies Zhamu as the officer leading this punitive force.
